raw_response:
I am not so good with numbers and book things. I only know what I do every year, and what my neighbors do. Let me think through it.

Last year my wheat gave me maybe 450 jin per mu — not bad, not the best. My man next door got 500 jin, he said he put more fertilizer. So this year I will not cut back. My 8 mu, I do wheat in winter, maize in summer, same as always, same as everyone here.

For wheat, before planting I will spread 2 bags of compound fertilizer (复合肥) per mu — that is 100 jin, about 50 kg. Then in spring when the wheat turns green, I put urea, maybe half a bag per mu, 20 jin or so. Water from the well — I give wheat water when it goes into winter, then in spring twice, then when grain is filling. Four times is what I always do. If I skip the spring water and it is dry, the grain is small, I saw that happen to my cousin.

For maize after wheat, I plant the hybrid seed from the dealer in town — everyone buys that one, the bag with the red picture. I put 1 bag compound fertilizer per mu at planting, then when the maize is knee-high I put urea, maybe 30 jin. Maize gets rain in summer so I only water once or twice if it is dry. Spray for the borer worm two times, and before flowering spray once more if I see bugs.

I till with the rotary machine — we hire the tractor man in the village, 40 yuan per mu. Plough is too expensive and slow.

I do not want to waste money but also I cannot risk a bad harvest. 7 mouths to feed, some work outside but the grain still matters. Better to put one extra bag than lose 100 jin.
